gen-eater-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text brings a literary, dignified voice, with a big visible entrance into each curve and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height. Eater's gappy, jagged menace sits above it.
gen-eater-gf-piazzolla: Eater drags in a dark, aggressive mood, its thin strokes hairline-free and its letters spaced far apart, while Piazzolla keeps lowercase nearly as tall as capitals. Both stay readable.
gen-eater-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional and refined, with counters spilling into the space around them. Eater's thin and thick strokes feel more comfortable than its dark mood suggests, so a long page of Scope One text feels settled underneath.
gen-eater-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, its tall a, e and s opening up generously. And Eater's quiet shifts in line weight, like brushed watercolor, give that steady text a darker, rougher doorway.
gen-eater-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum lifts its x-height high and opens its c like a bent paperclip. But Eater does the loud work, curves holding real weight even at their thinnest, while Suwannaphum does the patient telling.
gen-flavors-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional and refined, its counters spilling out into the space around each letter. Flavors does the shouting with towering lowercase and diagonals as heavy as stems, while Scope One does the quiet explaining.
gen-flavors-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px arrives bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, e and s. Flavors, whimsical and commanding above it, has diagonals as heavy as the verticals.
gen-flavors-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified, editorial Suwannaphum has a high x-height and a c as open as a bent paperclip. Suwannaphum keeps a long page moving steadily beneath Flavors, whose round letters have rims as heavy as the stems.
gen-gf-metamorphous-poppins: Poppins reads modern and clean, with no thick-thin flicker and loose, rope-like curves that never knot at the ends. And Metamorphous adds a gentle modulation and generous sidebearings above it, so the two feel like a stately hall opening onto a bright room.
gen-gf-offside-poppins: Wide-tracked and wilful, Offside leaves its curves open and keeps one quiet, level beat with no accents of weight. Poppins sits under it, modern and round-tipped.
